info.name: Sanad Tech API
info.description:
# سند التقنية — Sanad Tech API

The **single, fully-documented map of every endpoint** behind the API gateway. A frontend developer should be able to integrate against this collection without reading the backend code. Kept in sync with the code by rule **DOC2** — every endpoint added or changed updates this collection in the same change.

## Global conventions

- **Gateway is the only public entry (MS4).** Every route lives under the `api` prefix. Default `{{baseUrl}}` = `http://localhost:8190/api` (the dev stack through nginx — `NGINX_PORT` def `8190`).
- **Response envelope (N9).** Every HTTP response is wrapped:
  `{ "success": boolean, "message": string, "data": <payload>, "path": string, "timestamp": ISO }`.
  Read the real payload from `data`. Errors set `success:false`, `data:null`, and an HTTP error status.
- **Auth.** RS256 bearer access token in `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` (collection default). Public routes override to *no auth*. The token is short-lived (~15 min); refresh rotates it. Authorization is enforced at the gateway edge against the token's `permissions` claim (`<resource>.<action>`; the global `manage` wildcard covers everything).
- **Locales.** Arabic is the default (RTL); English is secondary. Translatable values are `{ "ar": string, "en": string }`.
- **Validation.** Request bodies are `.strict()` Zod schemas — unknown fields are rejected (HTTP 400).
- **Rate limiting + request ids (P8.10.A).** Every route passes a Redis-backed limiter keyed on your **client ip**, with limits resolved live from settings (**Settings → Security → Request limits**, so they change without a redeploy). Counted responses carry `X-RateLimit-Limit` / `X-RateLimit-Remaining` / `X-RateLimit-Reset` (seconds); exceeding a bucket returns **HTTP 429** with `Retry-After` and a localized `security.rateLimited` message. Buckets are separate — `auth` (all of `/auth/*`, tight), `lead` (public `POST /leads` only), `default` (everything else); `/health` is exempt. The limiter **fails open**: if Redis or settings is unreachable the request is allowed, never refused. Every response also carries **`X-Request-Id`** — quote it in a bug report and it will match the audit row and the nginx access-log line.
- **Body size.** Bodies are capped at **1 MB** (JSON) / 100 KB (form-encoded) at both nginx and the gateway; oversize returns HTTP 413. Media upload is presigned direct-to-R2, so no file bytes pass through this API.
- **CORS.** Deny-by-default and empty outside development — the admin portal is same-origin through nginx and the website fetches server-side, so no browser origin needs it. Postman is unaffected (it is not a browser).
- **Run order.** Call **Auth → Login** first (it captures `{{accessToken}}`/`{{refreshToken}}`/`{{userId}}` automatically), then any guarded request.
- **Seed admin (dev):** `admin@sanad.tech` / `change-me-admin`.

## Folders
- **Health** — gateway liveness.
- **Auth** — login / refresh / logout / me.
- **Identity** — user management (RBAC-guarded).
- **Branding** — public branding read + admin write (settings-service).

request.description:
**Purpose:** confirm the gateway is up.

**Auth:** public.

**Returns** `data`: `{ status: 'ok', uptime, ... }` (envelope-wrapped, N9).

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Email/password login, token refresh (rotated), logout, and the current-user probe. **Start here** — Login captures the tokens.

**Rate limit:** the whole folder shares the tight `auth` bucket (coded default 10 requests / 5 min per ip) — credential stuffing does not care which of login/refresh/logout it hammers. Exceeding it returns 429 + `Retry-After`.

request.description:
**Purpose:** exchange email + password for an access/refresh token pair + the authenticated user.

**Auth:** public.

**Body** (required, `.strict()`):

| field | type | rules |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | valid email |
| `password` | string | non-empty |

**Returns** `data`:
- `tokens`: `{ access, refresh }` (RS256 JWTs; access ~15 min)
- `user`: `{ id, email, name, roles: string[], isActive }`

_The test script stores `access`→`{{accessToken}}`, `refresh`→`{{refreshToken}}`, `user.id`→`{{userId}}`._

**Purpose:** rotate the token pair using a valid refresh token. The old refresh token is revoked (single-use).

**Auth:** public (the refresh token IS the credential).

**Body:** `{ refresh: string }` (`.strict()`).

**Returns** `data`: `{ access, refresh }` — a NEW pair. Reusing an old refresh token → 401.

**Purpose:** revoke a refresh token. Idempotent — a malformed/expired token is a no-op, not an error.

**Auth:** public.

**Body:** `{ refresh: string }`.

**Returns** `data`: `{ revoked: boolean }`.

**Purpose:** return the identity encoded in the current access token (the sample authenticated route).

**Auth:** bearer (`{{accessToken}}`).

**Returns** `data`: `{ userId, roles: string[], permissions: string[], email? }`. Admin carries `permissions:['manage']`.

item.name: Identity
item.description: User management owned by the identity-service. RBAC-guarded at the gateway edge (MS4).

request.description:
**Purpose:** paginated, searchable list of users.

**Auth:** bearer + permission `identity.users.read` (admin `manage` covers it). Missing → 403; no token → 401.

**Query** (all optional): `page` (≥1), `pageSize` (1–100), `search` (email/name ilike), `sort` (`email|name|createdAt`), `order` (`asc|desc`).

**Returns** `data`: `{ items: Array<{ id, email, name, roles: string[], isActive }>, meta: { total, page, pageSize, ... } }`.

item.name: Branding
item.description: Visual-identity branding resolved by the settings-service (override → global → coded default, U9). The website reads it unauthenticated; admins write it.

request.description:
**Purpose:** the fully-resolved branding record for the website/admin. **Always complete** — unset leaves fall back to coded defaults (F7), so it never renders blank.

**Auth:** **public**.

**Returns** `data`: `BrandingRecord` —
- `brand`: `{ name, tagline, shortDesc }` (each `{ar,en}`)
- `logoUrl`, `faviconUrl`: `string|null`
- `colors`: `{ primary, secondary, pageAccents{landing,about,services,serviceDetail}, surface{bg,track,s1,s2}, text{base,dim,muted,faint} }`
- `fonts`: `{ sans, mono }`
- `social`: `{ twitter,linkedin,instagram,github,youtube }` (each `string|null`)
- `contact`: `{ email, phone: string|null, address: {ar,en}|null }`

**Purpose:** apply a **deep-partial** branding update. Only the leaves you send change; everything else keeps its global/default value. Emits `settings.changed` and busts the cache.

**Auth:** bearer + permission `settings.manage` (admin `manage` covers it). Missing → 403.

**Body:** a deep-partial of `BrandingRecord` (`.strict()`). Colors must be hex (`#abc`/`#aabbcc`); social/contact URLs validated; localized leaves are `{ar,en}`; nullable leaves accept `null` to clear.

**Returns** `data`: the re-resolved `BrandingRecord`.

item.name: Integrations
item.description: Capability -> providers -> active provider (N13). Masked reads need settings.integrations.read; configure/activate/test need settings.integrations.<capability>.manage.

request.description:
Write the CORS policy that unblocks browser uploads, then RE-READ it — the response is the observed status, not an assumed one.

**Auth:** bearer · requires `settings.integrations.storage.manage`.

Needs an R2 API token with **bucket-configuration write** ("Admin Read & Write"). An object-scoped token comes back as `cannot-check` + the vendor message rather than an error — the UI then offers the copy-paste policy instead of a button that would fail.

Allowed origins come from the service's `ADMIN_PUBLIC_ORIGINS` (APP_ENV-driven).

item.name: Notifications
item.description: In-app notifications served by the notifications-service (P6). Scoped to the caller (their roles ∪ id) — you only see your own. Bearer + `notification.read`.

request.description:
**Purpose:** the caller's in-app notices, newest first.

**Auth:** bearer + `notification.read`.

**Query** (`.strict()`): `page`, `pageSize` (≤100), `search`, `sort`, `order`, optional `unread` (`'true'|'false'`, N7).

**Returns** `data`: `{ items: Notification[], meta }`. Each `Notification` = `{ id, channel, type, payload, readAt|null, createdAt }`.

**Purpose:** mark one in-app notice read (only if it belongs to you).

**Auth:** bearer + `notification.read`.

**Path:** `:id` = the notification id (`{{notificationId}}`).

**Returns** `data`: the updated `Notification`. 404 if not found/owned.

item.name: Media
item.description: Image/file storage on Cloudflare R2 via the media-service (P4). Signed-upload flow: ask for a presigned URL, PUT the bytes **directly to R2** (not through the gateway), then confirm. All routes require auth; reads need `media.read`, mutations `media.manage` (admin `manage` covers both).

request.description:
**Purpose:** validate + create a `pending` asset and mint a presigned **PUT** URL.

**Auth:** bearer + `media.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `filename`, `contentType` (must be in the allowlist: png/jpeg/webp/gif/svg/pdf), `size` (≤ `MEDIA_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES`), optional `folderId`, optional `alt {ar,en}`.

**Returns** `data`: `{ asset: MediaAsset (status 'pending'), upload: { url, method:'PUT', headers, expiresAt } }`. The test script captures `mediaAssetId` + `mediaUploadUrl`.

**Next:** PUT the bytes to `{{mediaUploadUrl}}` (directly to R2, outside this collection), then **Confirm upload**.

**Purpose:** mark the asset `ready` after the direct-to-R2 PUT; capture dimensions and finalize `alt`. Best-effort HEADs the object to record the real size.

**Auth:** bearer + `media.manage`.

**Path:** `:id` = the asset id (`{{mediaAssetId}}`).

**Body** (`.strict()`): optional `width`, `height`, `alt {ar,en}`.

**Returns** `data`: `MediaAsset` (status `'ready'`, with the resolved CDN `url`).

**Purpose:** a paginated, searchable, filterable page of assets.

**Auth:** bearer + `media.read`.

**Query** (`.strict()`): `page`, `pageSize` (≤100), `search` (filename), `sort`, `order` (asc/desc), `folderId`, `type` (MIME contains, e.g. `image`).

**Returns** `data`: `{ items: MediaAsset[], meta: { page,pageSize,total,totalPages } }`. Each item carries its resolved CDN `url` and `alt {ar,en}`.

**Purpose:** a single asset by id.

**Auth:** bearer + `media.read`.

**Path:** `:id` (`{{mediaAssetId}}`).

**Returns** `data`: `MediaAsset`. 404 if not found.

**Purpose:** batch-resolve content media ids → public CDN refs so the website (an anonymous visitor) renders images without a token (WEB1).

**Auth:** NONE — the only UNGUARDED media route. Declared before `GET /media/:id` so the literal path wins.

**Query:** `ids` = comma-separated UUIDs (blanks/dupes dropped; max 100).

**Returns** `data`: `PublicMediaRef[]` = `{ id, url, alt, width, height }` — only `ready`, non-deleted assets that exist (unknown ids absent; `[]` when none). A malformed id → 400.

**Purpose:** create a media folder.

**Auth:** bearer + `media.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `name`, optional `parentId`.

**Returns** `data`: `MediaFolder`.

**Purpose:** list media folders (flat in the MVP).

**Auth:** bearer + `media.read`.

**Query** (`.strict()`): optional `parentId`.

**Returns** `data`: `MediaFolder[]`.

**Purpose:** soft-delete an asset; emits `media.deleted` (Outbox, MS3) and best-effort removes the R2 object.

**Auth:** bearer + `media.manage`.

**Path:** `:id` (`{{mediaAssetId}}`).

**Returns** `data`: `{ id }`.

The whole folder tree with per-folder asset counts — the media explorer's side pane in ONE request (a count per node would be N+1).

**Auth:** bearer · requires `media.read`.

**Returns:** `{ roots: MediaFolderNode[], rootAssetCount }` where a node is a `MediaFolder` plus `assetCount` (DIRECT children only, not recursive) and `children[]`. Siblings come back name-sorted; a folder whose parent is missing is rescued to the root rather than dropped. `rootAssetCount` is the number of assets in NO folder.

Rename and/or re-parent a folder — the tree's inline rename and its drag-to-reparent.

**Auth:** bearer · requires `media.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`, at least one key required):
- `name` — 1..120 chars, optional.
- `parentId` — **tri-state**: omit to keep the current parent, `null` to move to the root, a uuid to move under that folder.

**Errors:** `404` unknown folder · `409` a live sibling already uses that name (case-insensitive) · `400` the move would put the folder inside itself or a descendant.

Delete a folder. Assets are NEVER destroyed as a side effect.

**Auth:** bearer · requires `media.manage`.

**Query:** `strategy` = `block` (default — refuse a non-empty folder and report what is inside) or `reparent` (move its assets + subfolders up one level, then delete). There is deliberately no recursive delete.

**Errors:** `404` unknown folder · `409` non-empty under `block` (the message names how many files and subfolders remain).

Move assets into a folder — what a drag-and-drop in the explorer performs. Bulk by design: a multi-select drag is ONE request, not N.

**Auth:** bearer · requires `media.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `ids` — 1..200 asset uuids · `folderId` — destination uuid, or `null` for the root (nullable, not optional: dropping onto the root is an explicit destination).

**Returns:** `{ movedIds, missingIds }` — ids that no longer exist are REPORTED, never silently skipped, so the caller can reconcile its optimistic state.

item.name: Content
item.description: The CMS surface (P5): the Page→Section→Block tree + the services collection. **Public** reads (the website renders them unauthenticated, never blank — coded defaults are seeded) and **guarded** admin writes (`content.read` to list, `content.manage` to write). Request/response shapes mirror `@sanad/contracts` content domain; bodies are `.strict()` (unknown keys 400). Translatable copy is sent + returned in BOTH locales `{ar,en}`.

request.description:
**Purpose:** the assembled, published Page→Section→Block tree the website renders (WEB2).

**Auth:** none (public).

**Returns** `data`: `PageTree` — `{ id, slug, status, title{ar,en}, metaTitle, metaDescription, sections: [{ type, eyebrow, title, subtitle, blocks: [{ type, data, imageMediaId, title, body }], config, collection }] }`. A collection-backed section carries `config` (`{ mode:'featured'|'picked'|'all', limit?, ids }` or `null`) and `collection` — the records hydrated in-service: `services` → `{ collection:'services', items:[ServiceItem] }`, `trust` → `{ collection:'portfolio', items:[PortfolioProjectItem] }` (the domain constellation groups them by category), `work` → `{ collection:'portfolio', items:[PortfolioProjectItem] }` (the WEB10 case-study orbit, covers resolved from `coverMediaId`), `testimonials` → `{ collection:'testimonials', items:[TestimonialItem] }` (the quote wall, author photos resolved from `avatarMediaId`), `blog` → `{ collection:'blog', items:[BlogPostItem] }` (the log teaser, covers resolved from `coverMediaId`, published-only on the public path), `faq` → `{ collection:'faq', items:[FaqItem] }` (the `/faq` accordion, Phase 5), `team` → `{ collection:'team', items:[TeamMemberItem] }` (the `/about` roster, avatars resolved from `avatarMediaId`, Phase 5), else `null`. Seeded page slugs: `landing`, `privacy`, `terms`, and the Phase-5 marketing pages `about` + `faq`. `section.type` now includes `richtext`/`faq`/`team`. 404 if no published page matches the slug.

**Purpose:** the admin page list (P7).

**Auth:** bearer + `content.read`.

**Returns** `data`: `Paginated<PageSummary>`.

**Purpose:** create or update a page meta + both-locale copy. `id` present → update; absent → create (keyed on unique `slug`).

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `slug`, `status` (`draft`/`published`), `sortOrder`, `title{ar,en}` (required), optional `metaTitle`/`metaDescription`.

**Returns** `data`: `PageSummary`. Captures `contentPageId`. 409 on a duplicate slug.

**Purpose:** create or update a section within a page. `id` present → update.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `pageId`, `type` (hero/trust/services/process/work/stats/testimonials/blog/cta/richtext), `sortOrder`, `published`, optional `eyebrow`/`title`/`subtitle` `{ar,en}`, optional `config` (`{ mode:'featured'|'picked'|'all', limit?, ids }` — the collection link for a collection-backed section, Phase 3; written only when present, so an inline copy edit never wipes it).

**Returns** `data`: `SectionNode` (with its blocks + hydrated `collection`). Captures `contentSectionId`.

**Purpose:** create or update a block within a section. `id` present → update.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `sectionId`, `type` (text/richtext/stat/step/feature/image/cta), `sortOrder`, `data` (non-translatable jsonb: stat values in Western digits, icon keys, urls), optional `imageMediaId` (soft media ref), optional `title`/`body` `{ar,en}`.

**Returns** `data`: `BlockNode`. Captures `contentBlockId`.

**Purpose:** soft-delete a block.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `{ id }`.

**Purpose:** the services grid (public website).

**Auth:** none (public).

**Query** (`.strict()`): standard list (`page`/`pageSize`/`search`/`sort`/`order`) + whitelisted `category` (`core`/`support`). `search` matches the translatable title/summary in either locale.

**Returns** `data`: `Paginated<ServiceItem>` (each with `title`/`summary`/`detailBody` `{ar,en}`).

**Purpose:** a service detail page by slug (public).

**Auth:** none (public).

**Returns** `data`: `ServiceItem`. 404 if absent.

**Purpose:** create a service + both-locale copy.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `slug`, `category`, optional `iconKey`/`coverMediaId`, `sortOrder`, `title{ar,en}` (required), optional `summary`/`detailBody`.

**Returns** `data`: `ServiceItem`. Captures `contentServiceId`. 409 on duplicate slug.

**Purpose:** update a service (partial). Only provided fields change; translatable fields carry both locales.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `ServiceItem`.

**Purpose:** soft-delete a service.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `{ id }`.

item.name: Testimonials
item.description: The client testimonials collection (P5). **Public** list (the website social-proof section) + **guarded** admin writes (`content.manage`). No detail-by-slug route — testimonials are listed. Translatable `quote`/`authorRole`/`companyDescriptor` carry `{ar,en}`.

request.description:
**Purpose:** the testimonials section (public website).

**Auth:** none (public).

**Query** (`.strict()`): standard list + whitelisted `featured` (`true`/`false` — literal, never coerced, N7). `search` matches the translatable quote/role in either locale.

**Returns** `data`: `Paginated<TestimonialItem>` (each with `quote`/`authorRole`/`companyDescriptor` `{ar,en}`).

**Purpose:** create a testimonial + both-locale copy.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `authorName` (required proper noun), optional `companyName`/`avatarMediaId`/`rating` (1–5), `featured`, `sortOrder`, `quote{ar,en}` (required), optional `authorRole`/`companyDescriptor`.

**Returns** `data`: `TestimonialItem`. Captures `contentTestimonialId`.

**Purpose:** update a testimonial (partial). Only provided fields change; translatable fields carry both locales.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `TestimonialItem`.

**Purpose:** soft-delete a testimonial.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `{ id }`.

item.name: Team
item.description: The team-members collection (P5 — the About page). **Public** list + detail-by-slug + **guarded** admin writes (`content.manage`). Translatable `name`/`role`/`bio` carry `{ar,en}`.

request.description:
**Purpose:** the team grid (public website About page).

**Auth:** none (public).

**Query** (`.strict()`): standard list + whitelisted `featured` (`true`/`false` — literal, never coerced, N7). `search` matches the translatable name/role in either locale.

**Returns** `data`: `Paginated<TeamMemberItem>` (each with `name`/`role`/`bio` `{ar,en}`).

**Purpose:** a team member by slug (public).

**Auth:** none (public).

**Returns** `data`: `TeamMemberItem`. 404 if absent.

**Purpose:** create a team member + both-locale copy.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `slug` (unique), optional `avatarMediaId`/`email`/`linkedinUrl`/`githubUrl`, `featured`, `sortOrder`, `name{ar,en}` + `role{ar,en}` (required), optional `bio`.

**Returns** `data`: `TeamMemberItem`. Captures `contentTeamMemberId`. 409 on duplicate slug.

**Purpose:** update a team member (partial). Only provided fields change; translatable fields carry both locales.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `TeamMemberItem`.

**Purpose:** soft-delete a team member.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `{ id }`.

item.name: Portfolio
item.description: The portfolio / case-studies collection (P5). **Public** category list + project grid (published only) + project detail-by-slug (published only); guarded `content.read` **manage** list (sees drafts); guarded `content.manage` writes. Projects embed their category on read (`{id,slug,name{ar,en}}`) and take `categoryId` on write. `status` gates visibility (drafts never leak — N7); `publishedAt` is server-stamped on first publish.

request.description:
**Purpose:** the work-grid category filter (public).

**Auth:** none.

**Returns** `data`: `Paginated<PortfolioCategoryItem>` (each with `name{ar,en}`).

**Purpose:** create a portfolio category.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `slug` (unique), `sortOrder`, `name{ar,en}`.

**Returns** `data`: `PortfolioCategoryItem`. Captures `contentPortfolioCategoryId`. 409 on duplicate slug.

**Purpose:** update a portfolio category (partial).

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `PortfolioCategoryItem`.

**Purpose:** soft-delete a portfolio category (projects' `category_id` → null).

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `{ id }`.

**Purpose:** the public work grid. The gateway FORCES `status=published` — a client can never see drafts (N7).

**Auth:** none.

**Query** (`.strict()`): standard list + whitelisted `categoryId`/`featured`. `search` matches the translatable title/summary in either locale.

**Returns** `data`: `Paginated<PortfolioProjectItem>` (category embedded).

**Purpose:** the admin project list — sees drafts. Honors the supplied `status` (or omit to see all).

**Auth:** bearer + `content.read`.

**Returns** `data`: `Paginated<PortfolioProjectItem>`.

**Purpose:** a case-study detail by slug (public).

**Auth:** none.

**Returns** `data`: `PortfolioProjectItem` (category embedded). 404 if absent OR a draft (drafts never leak).

body.raw:
{
  "slug": "tadawul-pay",
  "categoryId": "{{contentPortfolioCategoryId}}",
  "clientName": "Tadawul Pay",
  "status": "draft",
  "featured": true,
  "sortOrder": 0,
  "title": { "ar": "تداول باي", "en": "Tadawul Pay" },
  "summary": { "ar": "منصّة مدفوعات", "en": "A payments platform" },
  "challenge": { "ar": "التحدي", "en": "The challenge" },
  "solution": { "ar": "الحل", "en": "The solution" },
  "result": { "ar": "النتيجة", "en": "The result" }
}

request.description:
**Purpose:** create a case study + both-locale copy.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `slug` (unique), optional `categoryId`/`coverMediaId`/`clientName`/`projectUrl`, `status` (default `draft`), `featured`, `sortOrder`, `title{ar,en}` (required), optional `summary`/`challenge`/`solution`/`result`. `publishedAt` is server-managed (never sent).

**Returns** `data`: `PortfolioProjectItem`. Captures `contentPortfolioId`. 409 on duplicate slug.

**Purpose:** update a project (partial). Setting `status=published` the first time stamps `publishedAt` server-side.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `PortfolioProjectItem`.

**Purpose:** soft-delete a case study.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `{ id }`.

item.name: Blog
item.description: The blog collection (P5). Translatable **categories** + **tags** (lookups) + **posts** (articles). **Public** category/tag lists, post grid (published only) + post detail-by-slug (published only); guarded `content.read` **manage** list (sees drafts); guarded `content.manage` writes. Posts embed `category`/`author`/`tags` on read (`{id,slug,name{ar,en}}`) and take `categoryId`/`authorTeamMemberId`/`tagIds` on write (`tagIds` is the M2M set; sending it on update REPLACES the set). `status` gates visibility (drafts never leak — N7); `publishedAt` is server-stamped on first publish.

request.description:
**Purpose:** the blog category filter (public).

**Auth:** none.

**Returns** `data`: `Paginated<BlogCategoryItem>` (each with `name{ar,en}`, `description{ar,en}`).

**Purpose:** create a blog category.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `slug` (unique), `sortOrder`, `name{ar,en}` (required), optional `description{ar,en}`.

**Returns** `data`: `BlogCategoryItem`. Captures `contentBlogCategoryId`. 409 on duplicate slug.

**Purpose:** update a blog category (partial).

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `BlogCategoryItem`.

**Purpose:** soft-delete a blog category (posts' `category_id` → null).

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `{ id }`.

**Purpose:** the blog topic chips (public).

**Auth:** none.

**Returns** `data`: `Paginated<BlogTagItem>` (each with `name{ar,en}`).

**Purpose:** create a blog tag.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `slug` (unique), `sortOrder`, `name{ar,en}` (required).

**Returns** `data`: `BlogTagItem`. Captures `contentBlogTagId`. 409 on duplicate slug.

**Purpose:** update a blog tag (partial).

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `BlogTagItem`.

**Purpose:** soft-delete a blog tag (its M2M links cascade away).

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Returns** `data`: `{ id }`.

**Purpose:** the public blog index. The gateway FORCES `status=published` — a client can never see drafts (N7).

**Auth:** none.

**Query** (`.strict()`): standard list + whitelisted `categoryId`. `search` matches the translatable title/excerpt in either locale.

item.name: Leads
item.description:
The website contact / request-a-project capture (P5). `POST /leads` is **public** — it persists a lead and emits `lead.created` (Outbox, MS3) for the notifications service. The inbox (list + status) is **guarded** by `content.manage`.

**Rate limit:** the public `POST /leads` uses the `lead` bucket (coded default 20 / hour per ip — generous because Gulf carriers use CGNAT, so real visitors share addresses). The guarded inbox routes (list / update status) stay on `default`, so an admin paging leads never spends the anti-spam budget.

**Phone (P8.10.B1):** a lead carries a required, per-country-validated `phone` stored as E.164. `GET /leads`'s `search` filter covers it alongside name/email/company, and every `Lead` response exposes `phone` (null only for leads captured before the field existed).

**Duplicate detection (P8.10.B2):** a submission matching an existing NON-ARCHIVED lead by email (case-insensitive) or phone, whose last submission is inside the `security.leads.duplicateWindowSeconds` window (default 24h, admin-tunable), is ABSORBED: no second row is created, `submissionCount` / `lastSubmittedAt` move, an `audit_log` row records the new payload, and `lead.resubmitted` is emitted instead of `lead.created`. `POST /leads` still returns 201 with the lead id either way — the response deliberately does not reveal which happened.

request.description:
**Purpose:** submit a contact / request-a-project lead.

**Auth:** none (public).

**Body** (`.strict()`): `name`, `email`, **`phone`** (REQUIRED since P8.10.B1 — validated per-country and normalized to E.164 on the way in, so `+966 50 123 4567` is stored as `+966501234567`; a bare national number is rejected, and an invalid one returns 400 with the localized `validation.invalidPhone` message on the `phone` field), optional `company`/`budget`/`projectType`, `message`, `source` (`contact`/`request-project`, default `contact`), `locale` (default `ar`).

**Returns** `data`: `{ id }` (never echoes the row). Emits `lead.created`. Captures `leadId`.

**Purpose:** the admin leads inbox.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Query** (`.strict()`): standard list + whitelisted `status` (`new`/`contacted`/`archived`), `source` (`contact`/`request-project`) and `spam` (`clean`/`suspicious`/`likelySpam`, P8.10.B3 — the VERDICT, which the service resolves into the band's `spamScore` range; never a raw score). `search` matches name/email/phone/company. `sort` accepts any lead column, e.g. `spamScore` with `order=desc` to triage a flood from the top.

**Returns** `data`: `Paginated<Lead>` — each lead carries `spamScore` (0–100, advisory only: it never blocked, archived or hid the lead) and `spamSignals` (`[{ id, weight, n? }]`, the reasons it scored).

**Purpose:** transition a lead in the inbox.

**Auth:** bearer + `content.manage`.

**Body** (`.strict()`): `status` (`new`/`contacted`/`archived`).

**Returns** `data`: `Lead`.
